facts.statement: Traukutitan was a titanosaur sauropod dinosaur that lived during the late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: Traukutitan is a genus of titanosaur sauropod dinosaur which lived during the late Cretaceous (Santonian age).

facts.statement: Fossils of Traukutitan were found in the lowermost section of the Bajo de la Carpa Formation in North Patagonia, Argentina.
facts.quote: Fossils of Traukutitan were recovered from the lowermost section of the Bajo de la Carpa Formation (Neuquén Group) in North Patagonia of Argentina

facts.statement: The genus was formally named by Rubén Darío Juárez Valieri and Jorge Orlando Calvo in 2011.
facts.quote: Traukutitan was named by Rubén Darío Juárez Valieri and Calvo in 2011

facts.statement: Traukutitan is described as a large titanosaurid dinosaur.
facts.quote: Traukutitan has been described as a "large titanosaurid".

facts.statement: The middle tail vertebrae of Traukutitan have a flat posterior surface on their centra instead of a convex one.
facts.quote: The articular morphology of the middle tail vertebrae is a flat instead of a convex face on the posterior surface of their centra.

facts.statement: Researchers assigned Traukutitan to the family Titanosauridae and consider it a possible member of the clade Lognkosauria.
facts.quote: The authors assigned Traukutitan to the Titanosauridae; it is a possible member of the Lognkosauria.

facts.statement: Traukutitan lived at the end of the Cretaceous period, approximately between 86 and 83 million years ago, in what is now South America.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente entre 86 a 83 millones de años, en el Santoniense, en lo que hoy es Sudamérica

facts.statement: The articular morphology of the middle tail vertebrae is flat rather than having a convex face on the posterior surface of their centra.
facts.quote: La morfología articular de las vértebras del medio de la cola es plana en lugar de poseer una cara convexa de la superficie posterior de su centro.

facts.statement: Authors have assigned Traukutitan to Titanosauria, treating it as a possible member of Lognkosauria.
facts.quote: Los autores han asignado a Traukutitan a Titanosauria, tratándose de un posible miembro de Lognkosauria.

facts.statement: The time range for Traukutitan is the Santonian age, from 85.7 to 83.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Santonian to Santonian (85.7 to 83.6 million years ago)

facts.statement: The generic name refers to Trauku, an Araucanian mountain spirit often depicted as a giant, and titan, the name of Greek mythological giants.
facts.quote: The generic name refers to Trauku, the Araucanian mountain spirit, usually represented like a giant, and titan, the name of the Greek mythological giants.
